title: CurriculumModuleProfile
description: Schema version 1.0 for curriculum module profiles governing textbook domain ingestion and transfer benchmarks.

module_id.description: Versioned unique identifier for the curriculum module (e.g. psychology-memory-ch08-v1).

domain.description: Academic or operational domain identifier (e.g. cognitive-psychology, statistics).

learning_goal.description: Concise statement explaining why this material was selected for vault ingestion.

expected_capabilities.description: Concrete capabilities the vault should acquire or support following ingestion.

provenance_manifest.description: Relative path to the provenance manifest JSON.

content_files.description: List of content filenames to be processed in order.

topicality_terms.description: Key domain terms used for pre-flight preliminary topic verification.

min_topic_density.description: Minimum required mentions per 1000 characters during preliminary topic verification.

frozen_test_set.description: Relative path to the frozen evaluation test set JSON.

forbidden_outputs.description: Behaviors or memory states strictly forbidden for this module (e.g. unreviewed ACTIVE notes).

retroactive.description: True if this profile was documented after ingestion had already occurred.

retroactive_note.description: Mandatory explanation if retroactive is true.
